intro: A few recent pieces, spanning writing and photography.

items.title: My Community My University: How Community-Based Research Stopped a Coal Power Plant in Myanmar
items.description: Article about how Mi Tri fought back against a large-scale development project in her community with community based research tools. Part of the three-part series on community-based research tools.

items.title: Collaboration between The Bowl Spot and Chow Chow Chiang Mai
items.description: Hired to photograph a collaboration between Chow Chow and The Bowl Spot in Chiang Mai (two restaurants). Photographed the process in the kitchen, the exterior and interior of the restaurant, and the people behind the recipe.

items.title: Drawing the River Under Surveillance: How Communities in Laos Protect Their Rights and Natural Resources
items.description: Read about Bounmy, a Lao lawyer and community rights defender who works directly with communities to defend their legal rights. Part of the three-part series on community-based research tools.

items.title: Bringing Out Community Knowledge: LEAD Lessons from the Mekong
items.description: Co-authored a briefer on community-led research methods in the Mekong region, compiled from two multi-country training sessions.
